import json, os, time, hashlib, subprocess
from pathlib import Path

target=Path("/Users/steventran/Sonary")
req_id="sonary-daw-typecheck-stage-isolation-20261008-143"
key=hashlib.sha256(str(target.resolve()).encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
root=Path.home()/".do_again/projects"/key
base=root/"control/automation/do_again"
state=root/"state"

def read_json(p):
    try:
        v=json.loads(p.read_text())
        return v if isinstance(v,dict) else {}
    except Exception:
        return {}

claim_path=base/"claims"/f"{req_id}.json"
ledger_path=state/"ledger"/f"{req_id}.json"
claim=read_json(claim_path) if claim_path.is_file() else None
ledger=read_json(ledger_path) if ledger_path.is_file() else None

ps=subprocess.run(["ps","-axo","pid=,ppid=,etime=,command="],text=True,capture_output=True)
lines=ps.stdout.splitlines()

def proc_for_pid(pid):
    if not isinstance(pid,int) and not (isinstance(pid,str) and pid.isdigit()):
        return []
    needle=str(pid)
    return [line.strip() for line in lines if line.strip().split(None,1)[0]==needle]

candidate_pids=set()
for obj in (claim or {}, ledger or {}):
    for k,v in obj.items():
        if "pid" in str(k).lower() and (isinstance(v,int) or (isinstance(v,str) and v.isdigit())):
            candidate_pids.add(int(v))

out={
  "request_id":req_id,
  "claim_exists":claim_path.is_file(),
  "claim_path":str(claim_path),
  "claim_mtime":claim_path.stat().st_mtime if claim_path.is_file() else None,
  "claim_age_seconds":time.time()-claim_path.stat().st_mtime if claim_path.is_file() else None,
  "claim":claim,
  "ledger_exists":ledger_path.is_file(),
  "ledger_path":str(ledger_path),
  "ledger_mtime":ledger_path.stat().st_mtime if ledger_path.is_file() else None,
  "ledger_age_seconds":time.time()-ledger_path.stat().st_mtime if ledger_path.is_file() else None,
  "ledger":ledger,
  "candidate_pid_processes":{str(pid):proc_for_pid(pid) for pid in sorted(candidate_pids)},
  "service_processes":[line.strip() for line in lines if str(root) in line],
}
print(json.dumps(out,indent=2,sort_keys=True))
print("SONARY_CLAIM_LEDGER_DIAGNOSTIC_OK")
